text.p: The Turkish lira eased to 87,110 per dollar on Thursday from Wednesday's close of 87,080 on the central bank's higher dollar rate for banks' foreign exchange transfers.
The central bank set its dollar rate for banks' compulsory currency transfers at 87,000 lira at opening, and raised it to 87,100 later.

The overnight money rate closed at 71 percent after moving between 70-74.75 percent during the day. The central bank had lent 3.8 trillion lira overnight cash on Tuesday and the average o/n rate was 73.26 percent.

In the T-bill market, the downtrend continued due to the treasury's 112-day T-bill auction on Tuesday when the treasury sold 133.8 trillion lira T-bills. The yields fell by one-to-two points on Thursday.
The most active December 25 paper yield, sold at an average of 117.50 percent at yesterday's auction, traded at 115.55 percent.
The second active February 26 paper fell to 128.29 percent from 129.07 percent Tuesday close.
